{"code": "import numpy as np

# Final, precise computation: print only the exact numbers we will use in evidence

# Compute female control response rate
female_control_rate = data[(data['sex'] == 'F') & (data['arm'] == 'control')]['responded'].mean()

# Compute female treatment response rate
female_treatment_rate = data[(data['sex'] == 'F') & (data['arm'] == 'treatment')]['responded'].mean()

# Compute male control response rate
male_control_rate = data[(data['sex'] == 'M') & (data['arm'] == 'control')]['responded'].mean()

# Compute male treatment response rate
male_treatment_rate = data[(data['sex'] == 'M') & (data['arm'] == 'treatment')]['responded'].mean()

# Compute differences
female_diff = female_treatment_rate - female_control_rate
male_diff = male_treatment_rate - male_control_rate

# Compute control group sizes by sex
control_sex_counts = data[data['arm'] == 'control']['sex'].value_counts()

# Compute weights (control group size per sex / total control)
total_control = control_sex_counts.sum()
female_weight = control_sex_counts['F'] / total_control
male_weight = control_sex_counts['M'] / total_control

# Compute adjusted effect
adjusted_effect = female_diff * female_weight + male_diff * male_weight

# Print each value exactly as it will appear in the evidence
print(f"female_control_rate = {female_control_rate}")
print(f"female_treatment_rate = {female_treatment_rate}")
print(f"male_control_rate = {male_control_rate}")
print(f"male_treatment_rate = {male_treatment_rate}")
print(f"female_diff = {female_diff}")
print(f"male_diff = {male_diff}")
print(f"female_weight = {female_weight}")
print(f"male_weight = {male_weight}")
print(f"adjusted_effect = {adjusted_effect}")

# Assign to variables for final use
final_values = {
    'female_control_rate': female_control_rate,
    'female_treatment_rate': female_treatment_rate,
    'male_control_rate': male_control_rate,
    'male_treatment_rate': male_treatment_rate,
    'female_diff': female_diff,
    'male_diff': male_diff,
    'female_weight': female_weight,
    'male_weight': male_weight,
    'adjusted_effect': adjusted_effect
}"}
